text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was brought along by Sweepy Tosho
to search for ideas for new magic, when—

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho-san!
I came up with a new spell,
so would you mind taking another look at it...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A new magic spell...?
Wait, this is just an ordinary letter!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Truth is, a spell was cast on the letter,
and when exposed to the fountainhead of life,
the writing appears!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!! No time to waste!
Let's go, familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Urrrgh, why~~?!
No letters are showing up at all, whether I shine light on it or ask the sylphs!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Light nurtures life, and the wind carries seeds...
They're both the source of life! What else could there—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Right then, a woman who looked somewhat
familiar made a beeline straight toward us.
choice_data_list: Huh? Isn't that the person from earlier...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahh, I'm so thirsty~
I'll just drink some water from this plastic bottle~~

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
*glug, glug*... Pwah!
I feel alive again~. Water really is the source of life~~.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The source of life... The origin of that source, which means—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When Sweep Tosho rushed over to the river
and began exposing the letter to the water's surface—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah! Letters, there are letters! They're gradually emerging...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Umm... "I'm always cheering for you.
Good luck with your race!"—it says—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "...To think you'd go through the trouble of casting magic just to tell me this—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad at all! That's what I'd expect
from a fan of the genius magical girl, Sweepy!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose either!
I'll hit back with amazing magic
and show you the difference in our power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Time to go back and research, Familiar!
Huh-huuun♪

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, a return gift...!
I'm so glad I put my heart into thinking it through~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is showing her motivation.
The love of her fans really might be a kind of magic.
